verdict.rationale: Ente's official self-hosting guide shows Ente Auth running against a self-hosted instance at localhost:3003 or a machine IP. The llms.txt probe confirms that Ente's apps and server are open source, and synced codes are end-to-end encrypted. Missing for 10: detailed server deployment and configuration docs for the Auth sync backend, explicit confirmation that clients can be pointed exclusively at the self-hosted endpoint with no external dependencies, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted Auth setup.
